title: News + economic-calendar feeds are routinely maintained and watched (not one-off uploads)
note: OPERATOR DECISION 2026-10-26 ~11:25Z (chat, verbatim): "do we also have a work task for making sure the news feed is working and the calnder is updating regularly? Those should be routinely maintained and updated data feeds, not one off uploads". REVERSES the rule in econ-calendar-produce.yml ("a cadence must never silently mutate [config/economic_calendar.yaml] - its population stays an operator-gated, session-emitted change (Tier-3)"). Built: (1) econ-calendar-produce now passes --emit-config and lands config/economic_calendar.yaml via commit-to-main; only the events list is rewritten, a run with no forward events keeps the last good set, unchanged output is byte-identical; fetch window 14d -> 45d. (2) the existing scripts/macro/check_producer_liveness.py (extended with consumer-side checks) runs daily inside macro-producer-liveness.yml (no new cron; already in CADENCE_REGISTRY + claude-run-failure-alert): calendar newest event < 7d ahead or newest successful capture > 36h old; news_decisions silent > 12h with a crypto package open (N=12h: 1 of 999 inter-row gaps in the 1000-row tail 2026-10-07..10-26 exceeds it; median gap 7 min). stale and could_not_look are reported separately. Measured before the build: newest calendar event 2026-07-30; live news layer fresh (rows 11:03Z/11:13Z). Closes PI-20261025-8BRWED6K-0001. Tier-2 (changes what the live news layer reads): manager merges.  [WHY THE GATE EXISTED, and the defect (manager input 2026-10-26, operator called the gate 'a serious design flaw' ~11:27Z)] The 2026-07-29 design note (docs/research/M1-econ-calendar-spine-2026-07-29.md, 'Live-path change requiring operator approval') wanted ONE sign-off on the FIRST population of a live-path file. The workflow encoded it as a permanent 'never --emit-config'. Defect 1: a one-time approval was built as a permanent prohibition. Defect 2: no staleness detector watched the CONSUMED file; check_producer_liveness.py watched only the producer's output (econ_calendar_snapshots.jsonl, fresh), so it stayed green while config/economic_calendar.yaml sat at 2026-07-30. Fix: that same checker now also watches the consumed calendar (horizon >= 7d, refresh <= 36h) and news_decisions (via diag); no parallel checker.  [2026-10-26 13:27Z] #20310 merged (38f8bcf8) and deployed (VM sha 38f8bcf8b). OBSERVED via diag live_review_due: calendar_state read (was could_not_look), newest event 2026-11-06T13:30Z, read_state looked. PI-20261025-8BRWED6K-0001 closed on that. NOT YET OBSERVED: the feed-liveness alerts on their first scheduled run, and a scheduled (not hand-run) config refresh; row stays landed_unproven until both. 2026-10-27 econ-cal-landing: check_pr_landing.py gains econ_calendar_vouch (automation/econ-calendar-* branches): vouches ONLY config/economic_calendar.yaml when econ_calendar_produce.py --verify reproduces it byte-for-byte from committed captures and the file differs from the merge-base only in events:; foreign paths fall back to R5. Simulated against #20497's content: self-lands. landed_unproven until the next scheduled automation PR passes pr-landing-guard unaided.

observation.what: The first scheduled macro-producer-liveness run (12:00Z daily) with the consumer-side feed checks completes and reports the calendar and news feeds fresh, and the next scheduled econ-calendar-produce run (22:30Z) lands or no-ops the config refresh without blanking it
observation.how_to_check: Actions run history for macro-producer-liveness.yml and econ-calendar-produce.yml; git log -1 -- config/economic_calendar.yaml
